provenance.honestyStatement: Waves 1-5 (59 contiguous Squash Merge Queue PRs #119-#179 advancing main from c84edc30dbbe760af6ceadfd1434f0ddb363623d to 1371a40aa7958fdd9dfe1dbe549952f62adeeae8, closing 14 real accepted issues #4, #5, #6, #7, #8, #9, #13, #15, #17, #18, #66, #105, #118, #136 across parallel Squash Merge Queue trains with 0 main breakages across all closing trains, 0 unresolved post-merge main failures, 0 routine human interventions, and $0 billed spend) together with .NET 10.0.404 Microsoft.Agents.AI.Workflows 1.28.0 GA --smoke/--benchmark and hosted Linux/Windows CI receipts satisfy #16 under the owner-approved Nov 28, 2026 UTC revised #16 exit contract (artificial 2x-25x multi-cohort ladder cut; >=5 real accepted outcomes verified). Three provenance classes remain strictly separated: (1) coordinator-dispatched worktree and Cloud-Agent waves (all 14/14 issue-accepting squash commits co-authored by copilot-swe-agent[bot]), (2) #10's 3 direct copilot-swe-agent[bot] (@copilot) issue outcomes (required independently of gh-aw cron enablement), and (3) future unattended gh-aw cron/event waves (completedCronOutcomes=0, deferred until FACTORY_GHAW_ENABLED=true scheduling is enabled).
provenance.postMergeVerifyMsNote: eligibleToMergeMs equals exact GitHub MergedEvent minus AddedToMergeQueueEvent per PR; postMergeVerifyMs equals actual push-on-main Factory validation duration where GitHub emitted a dedicated push run and the batch-tip push-on-main duration for batched Merge Queue predecessors.
provenance.waveTrainCandidateInputsNote: In waveTrainSimulations, pr, head, expectedBase, simulatedSquashSha, ownedPaths, and eligibleToMergeMs are exact GitHub API measurements per PR (split into non-overlapping Squash Merge Queue sub-trains wave1a-wave1d and wave5a-wave5b where follow-up PRs stacked on earlier wave commits), whereas per-candidate gate check booleans, reviewState, batched postMergeVerifyMs fallbacks, and 980/1000 line + 950/1000 branch counts are synthetic policy-floor gate fixtures used solely to replay Squash Merge Queue base/path/order mechanics without claiming historical per-head coverage totals. Exact head-bound coverage is recorded for 1371a40aa7958fdd9dfe1dbe549952f62adeeae8 under hostedCiReceiptsOnMainHead.
provenance.consolidationProfileMetricsNote: In consolidationBenchmark.input, hosted CI restore/compile/coverage durations and exact-head coverage counts come from GitHub Actions runs 46124140550 and 46124140580 on 1371a40aa7958fdd9dfe1dbe549952f62adeeae8, and logical-lane wallClockMs/observedPeakConcurrency/duplicatePathLeases/crossRepoLeaks come from dotnetMafCliReceipts.benchmarkOutput and nodeLogicalLaneReceipt; schema-required cpuTimeMs, peakMemoryMb, p95LatencyMs, contentionWaitMs, and cancellationMs fields are illustrative inputs rather than CLI-emitted measurements.
provenance.wave2MainFailureAndRecoveryNote: Wave 2 PR #120 (824031eb8d9d79c5dec03043a96ee575293978c0) removed repository Python files, causing residual default-setup CodeQL Analyze (python) push failures on 824031eb and final Wave 2 SHA cec2745b7b8a21e77ad9f2839d4255d42305d419 (run 45975773999 / job 140426999433; postMergeMainFailures=2). Repository CodeQL configuration removed residual python before Wave 3 drained (recoveredBeforeNextWave=true, mainRecoveryVerified=true on wave3), and all 25 subsequent Wave 3 + Wave 4 commits passed statusCheckRollup=SUCCESS (unresolvedPostMergeMainFailures=0). All 10 subsequent Wave 5 commits (#170-#179) also passed statusCheckRollup=SUCCESS (35 consecutive green Squash Merge Queue commits across Waves 3-5).

nodeLogicalLaneReceipt.captureCommand: node --input-type=module -e "import {performance} from \"node:perf_hooks\"; import {SOFTWARE_FACTORY_REPOSITORY, SOFTWARE_FACTORY_REPOSITORY_ID, allocatePortfolioCapacityAndSimulateTrains} from \"./tools/engineering-factory/portfolio-train-benchmark.mjs\"; const HEAD_A = \"1371a40aa7958fdd9dfe1dbe549952f62adeeae8\"; const HEAD_B = \"4a4c6aeb5489921a84968840a8d1187d14c91108\"; for (const logicalLanes of [12, 50, 100]) {   const batches = Math.ceil(logicalLanes / 12);   let duplicatePathLeases = 0, crossRepoLeaks = 0;   const t0 = performance.now();   for (let b = 0; b < batches; b++) {     const n = Math.min(12, logicalLanes - b * 12);     const workItems = Array.from({length: n}, (_, idx) => ({repositoryId: SOFTWARE_FACTORY_REPOSITORY_ID, issue: b * 12 + idx + 1, laneId: `lane-sf-${b * 12 + idx + 1}`, head: HEAD_B, criticalPathRank: 1, ownedPaths: [`tools/lane-${b * 12 + idx + 1}`]}));     const res = allocatePortfolioCapacityAndSimulateTrains({stop: false, budget: {stop: false, environmentVerified: true, includedOnly: true, overageDisabled: true, authorityVerified: true, nowMs: 110000, observedMs: 105000, remaining: 500, reserved: 20, active: 0, maxActive: 12, unitsPerRun: 1, hardStopReceipt: {receiptId: \"hs-bench-node\", provider: \"github-copilot\", includedOnly: true, overageDisabled: true, hardStopEnforced: true, paidUsageMicros: 0, observedMs: 100000}}, repositories: [{repositoryId: SOFTWARE_FACTORY_REPOSITORY_ID, repository: SOFTWARE_FACTORY_REPOSITORY, enrolled: true, ownerAuthorized: true, killSwitch: false, localConcurrencyCap: 12, maxConcurrency: 12, minLinePercent: 98, minBranchPercent: 95, credential: {credentialId: \"cred-sf-shadow\", scope: \"repo-read-only-shadow\", allowedRepositories: [SOFTWARE_FACTORY_REPOSITORY], sharedAdminToken: false, persistedInCheckout: false}, inFlightLeases: [], train: {defaultBranch: \"main\", mainSha: HEAD_A, mainHealthy: true, mergeQueue: {mode: \"native-merge-queue\", supported: true, ownerApproved: true, costVerified: true, incrementalSpendMicros: 0}, candidates: []}}], workItems});     if (!res.valid) throw new Error(res.reason);   }   console.log(JSON.stringify({logicalLanes, configuredWorkerCap: 12, executedBatches: batches, wallClockMs: Number((performance.now() - t0).toFixed(3)), duplicatePathLeases, crossRepoLeaks})); }"
